manifest.data:

  "scope": "/",

  "background_color": "#f5f3ec",
  "theme_color": "#2347d9",

      "src": "/icons/icon-192.png",
      "sizes": "192x192",

      "purpose": "any"
    },
    {
      "src": "/icons/icon-512.png",
      "sizes": "512x512",
      "type": "image/png",
      "purpose": "any"
    },
    {
      "src": "/icons/icon-512.png",
      "sizes": "512x512",

      "purpose": "maskable"

manifest.description: Practice exams and domain drills for cloud certifications.
